title: The resilient city
description: A city has seven competing opportunities and one constrained pilot budget. Find the strongest portfolio, coordinate delivery and test the funding loop.
goal: Allocate the city's energy resilience pilot budget using the supplied cost, benefit and implementation-risk assumptions.

opportunities.title: District energy storage
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative planning brief: district energy storage has a cost of 55 credits, an assumed resilience benefit of 80 points and implementation risk score 5. Permits and field performance are unverified.

opportunities.title: Industrial heat recovery
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative planning brief: industrial heat recovery connects a modeled waste-heat source to district demand. Pilot cost is 30 credits; assumed benefit is 61 resilience points; risk score is 3. These inputs are not measured savings.

opportunities.title: Adaptive demand response
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative planning brief: adaptive demand response shifts flexible loads in a pilot. Cost is 25 credits, assumed resilience benefit 57 points, and risk score 2. No live grid is connected.

opportunities.title: Water loss intelligence
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative planning brief: water loss intelligence prioritizes inspections. A 20-credit pilot has an assumed benefit of 43 resilience points and risk score 2. Field confirmation would be a separate operational task.

opportunities.title: Building cooling control
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative planning brief: building cooling control uses an assumed 25-credit pilot budget, 49 resilience points of benefit and risk score 2. Comfort constraints must be independently assessed before a real deployment.

opportunities.title: Electric fleet orchestration
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative planning brief: electric fleet orchestration coordinates charging and deliveries. Cost 40 credits, assumed resilience benefit 62 points, implementation risk score 4. Vehicle and charger availability are scenario assumptions.

opportunities.title: Urban simulation twin
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative planning brief: a city simulation twin supports scenario comparison. Cost 35 credits, assumed resilience benefit 50 points, risk score 3. A digital twin would need calibration against actual observations.

title: The discovery foundry
description: Turn a crowded research backlog into an executable portfolio. Compare compute, evidence quality and verification capacity before launching experiments.
goal: Prioritize reproducible research experiments within the laboratory's compute and implementation-risk budget.

opportunities.title: Large foundation-model run
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative research brief: a foundation-model run consumes 65 compute credits for an assumed value of 75 points. Risk score 6 reflects uncertainty, not a measured probability of failure.

opportunities.title: Evidence-first data curation
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative research brief: evidence-first data curation costs 20 credits, has an assumed research value of 48 points and risk score 1. Reproduction and source checks are explicit tasks.

opportunities.title: Small specialist models
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative research brief: small specialist models use 30 compute credits, with an assumed value of 62 research points and risk score 3. No trained model or benchmark advantage is claimed by this scenario.

opportunities.title: Symbolic hypothesis search
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative research brief: symbolic hypothesis search costs 25 credits and has an assumed value of 51 research points with risk score 2. Hypotheses still require experimental validation.

opportunities.title: Independent evaluation gym
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative research brief: an independent evaluation gym uses 15 credits and is assigned 39 research value points with risk score 1. Review capacity is a modeled resource, not proof of general intelligence.

opportunities.title: Adaptive world-model pilot
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative research brief: an adaptive world-model pilot costs 40 credits, with assumed research value 68 points and risk score 4. Simulator validity must be evaluated separately.

title: The enterprise frontier
description: Find the next useful automation portfolio. Make cost, operational risk and review effort visible, then export real mission inputs for your own agent.
goal: Select enterprise automation pilots that maximize the supplied benefit score while respecting budget and operational risk.

opportunities.title: Enterprise platform rebuild
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative operations brief: a platform rebuild costs 60 credits, has an assumed benefit of 76 points and risk score 6. No revenue or production outcome is implied.

opportunities.title: Internal evidence navigator
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative operations brief: an internal evidence navigator costs 20 credits, assumed benefit 46 points, risk score 2. Real use requires authorized documents and access controls.

opportunities.title: Capacity planning agent
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative operations brief: a capacity planning pilot costs 25 credits for an assumed 59 benefit points and risk score 2. Scheduling invariants can be tested independently.

opportunities.title: Document quality review
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative operations brief: document quality review costs 15 credits, assumed benefit 38 points and risk score 1. A human remains responsible for accepting the output.

opportunities.title: Demand planning workbench
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative operations brief: demand planning costs 20 credits, assumed benefit 42 points, risk score 2. Forecast evaluation must use a separate temporal holdout.

opportunities.title: Supplier resilience map
opportunities.evidence: Illustrative operations brief: supplier resilience mapping costs 30 credits, assumed benefit 53 points and risk score 3. The scenario contains no live supplier or market data.
